notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability twice by paying {4}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.
